card.name: The word years after an age number
card.fires_on: The word "years" right after an age number such as 12 or 13 in dosing headings for adults and pediatric patients. It is typically followed by "of age and older".

modes.label: Age cutoff in dose headings
modes.description: "years" after a number like 12 in a population line such as adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older.

modes.label: Age bands in tables
modes.description: "years" after a number in a dosage table row defining an age group.
modes.example: ADULTS (13<< years>> and older) UPPER RESPIRATORY

card.writes: It pushes the model toward age-related words such as age, adult, ages and the Chinese words for age.
card.plain: It fires on the word "years" when a dosing line gives the minimum age for a patient group.
